autoscale.description: [-] Automatic calibration to mWing (1:correction; 0: no correction)

factor_FixedTE.description: [-] calibration factor for fixed trailing edge mass

factor_FixedLE.description: [-] calibration factor for fixed leading edge mass

factor_LGsupport.description: [-] alibration factor for Landing Gear Support mass

factor_EngineAttachment.description: [-] calibration factor for Engine Attachment mass

factor_FoldableWingMechanism.description: [-] calibration factor for Foldable Wing Mechanism mass

factor_TotalMass.description: [-] calibration factor for total wing mass

nUlT.description: [-] Ultimate Load Factor; Based on manoeuverloads n = 1.5x2.5=3.75 (large aircraft)

NoEngines.description: [-] Number of engines on half wing

etaBoxOut.description: [-] Plan-view eta position end of wing box

rho_rib.description: [kg/m^2] Density of used material for Ribs (Default Aluminium alloy)

rho_Shell.description: [kg/m^2] Density of used material for S (Default Aluminium alloy)

rho_Spar.description: [kg/m^2] Density of used material for Spars (Default Aluminium alloy)

switch_LG.description: [-] switch: 1 = wing-mounted landing gears; 0 = No wing-mounting

switch_fuelTank.description: [-] switch: 1 = wing-mounted landing gears; 0 = No wing-mounting

eta_PointMass1.description: [-] rel. position of Additional Point Mass 1

kFLE.description: [-] factor for fixed-LE: k=1.0 without slats or Krueger, k=1.3 with slats

supportStructure.description: [N/m^2] Increase for Support Structure: 40 N/m^2 for single slotted Fowler flaps and double slotted flaps or 100 N/m^2 for double-slotted Fowler and triple-slotted flaps

kSupport.description: [-] factor for flap support mechanism: k=1.0 simple hinge external support, k=1.2 link/trank end external support, k=1.6 fowler flap hooked track external support

kSupportAdditional.description: [-] factor for additional flap support mechanism: k=0. no additional support, k=0.2 auxiliary trailing edge hinged flap

kSlot.description: [-] factor for number of slots: k=1.0 single-slotted; k=1.5 double-slotted with fixed nose vanes; k=2 double-slotted with articulating vanes

kBalance.description: [-] factor for aileron balancing: k=1.0 unbalanced ailerons, k=1.3 aerodynamic-balanced ailerons, k=1.54 mass-balanced ailerons

nUltimate.description: [-] Ultimate Load Factor; Based on manoeuverloads n = 1.5x2.5=3.75 (large aircraft)

autoscale_Mass.description: [-] Automatic calibration to mFuselage (1:correction; 0: no correction)

autoscale_xCoG.description: [-] Automatic calibration to fuselage x CoG (1:correction; 0: no correction)

factor_xCoG.description: [-] calibration factor for all component x cog´s

factor_Skin.description: [-] calibration factor for skin mass, only used in Torenbeek method

factor_Stringers.description: [-] calibration factor for other shell masses, including stiffeners and longerons (stringers), only used in Torenbeek method

factor_Frames.description: [-] calibration factor for frames mass, only used in Torenbeek method

factor_NonIdeal.description: [-] calibration factor for other masses due to non-ideal fuselage shape, only used in Torenbeek method

factor_Bulkheads.description: [-] calibration factor for pressure bulkheads mass

factor_Shell.description: [-] calibration factor for the sum of skin, stringer, frames, non-ideal and pressure bulkhead mass

factor_Secondaries.description: [-] calibration factor for secondary masses, including cabin floor, floor supports, doors, windows, cargo hold structures, fairing around the wing carry-through structure and attachment structures for the wing, tail and nose landing gear

factor_TotalMass.description: [-] calibration factor for total fuselage mass

xCoG_Miscellaneous.description: [m] miscellaneous mass x-CoG, if value = 0. the CoG is set to the total CoG without miscellaneous mass

zCoG_Miscellaneous.description: [m] miscellaneous mass z-CoG, if value = 0. the CoG is set to the total CoG without miscellaneous mass

switch_fullSizeRearBulkhead.description: [-] Switch for the consideration of 'full' size rear pressure bulkheads

testCase.description: Calculate the additional test case of operators items for different aircraft models (Boolean)

autoscale.description: [-] Automatic calibration to mOperatorItems (1:correction; 0: no correction)

factor_OperatorItems.description: [-] calibration factor for all operator items mass (used if autoscale deactivated)

factor_UnusableFuel.description: [-] calibration factor for unusable fuel mass

factor_AircraftDocuments.description: [-] calibration factor for aircraft documents and tools mass

factor_GalleyStructure.description: [-] calibration factor for galley structure mass

factor_PassengerSeats.description: [-] calibration factor for passenger seats mass

factor_CrewRest.description: [-] calibration factor for removable crew rest mass

factor_AdditionalCenterTank.description: [-] calibration factor for additional center tank mass

factor_SeatElectronicSystem.description: [-] calibration factor for seat electronic system mass

factor_EmergencyEquipment.description: [-] calibration factor for emergency equipment mass

factor_FluidToilets.description: [-] calibration factor for toilet fluid mass

factor_Oil.description: [-] calibration factor for engine and APU oil mass

numberSeatsFirstClass.description: [-] number of passenger seats in first class (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberSeatsBusinessClass.description: [-] number of passenger seats in business class (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberSeatsEconomyClass.description: [-] number of passenger seats in economy class (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

flightHours.description: [-] flight hours of design mission (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberFlightAttendants.description: [-] number of flight attendants (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberFlightCrew.description: [-] number of pilots (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberAisle.description: [-] number of cabin aisles (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

areaGalley.description: [m2] cabin area covered by galley structure or by full size trolleys (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberExitPairSingleLane.description: [-] number of exit pairs with one lane (all main exit types excpt for type A and B exits / if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberExitPairDoubleLane.description: [-] number of exit pairs with two lanes (exit type A and B / if value=auto auto calculation is used)

numberExitOverwing.description: [-] number of exit pairs over the wing (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

heightSlides.description: [m] maximum distance between ground and cabin floor (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

volumeFuelTotal.description: [m3] total fuel capacity of all tanks (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

volumeAdditionalCenterTank.description: [m3] fuel capacity of additional center tanks (if value=auto auto calculation is used)

mode.description: 0: AEO for TO and L; 1: Take off Balanced Field Length; 2: Take off Performance Sensitivity; 3: Landing Performance Sensitivity

dv1.description: Delta V1 step (used only in mode 1)

fuelConsume.description: Deciding if fuel is consumed e.g. for electric flight (0: False; 1: True)

additionalEngineVectors.description: Additional maps to read out of engine Decks

cLmaxTO.description: Maximum take-off lift coefficient (with extended flaps) [-]

cLmaxL.description: Maximum landing lift coefficient (with extended flaps) [-]

SpoilerLiftReduction.description: Lift reduction due to spoilers (1 = zero lift; 0 = 100% Lift) [-]

hAP_TO.description: Airport Elevation at beginning of runway during take-off [m]

hAP_L.description: Airport Elevation at beginning of runway during landing [m]

APgradient_TO.description: Runway with constant Gradient at TakeOff[deg]

APgradient_L.description: Runway with constant Gradient at Landing[deg]

surface.description: Choose between: Concrete (Standard); HardTurf; DryDirt; SoftTurf; WetConcrete; WetGrass; Snow

mRamp.description: Mass of Aircraft at beginning of taxi segment [kg]

mTakeOff.description: Mass of Aircraft at beginning of take-off segment [kg]

mLanding.description: Mass of Aircraft at beginning of approach segment [kg]

vEF.description: Speed at Engine Failure [m/s] (used only in mode 4)

alphaInc.description: The angle of incidence of the mean aerodynamic chord of the wing [deg]

cL_retraction.description: cL at which movables are retracted

T_limit.description: Thrust limit; set: value, default is 1.0 with no limit or e.g. with limit of 0.85
